verdict.rationale: First-party docs show several ways to run background automation: cron jobs, durable Workflows and Queues ([cloudflare-docs-9]). Workflows can chain steps, retry failed tasks automatically, persist state for weeks and pause for external events or approvals ([cloudflare-docs-27], [cloudflare-docs-42]). Event subscriptions let account events trigger Workers ([cloudflare-supp-event-subscriptions]), and Agents SDK agents have built-in scheduling and hibernate and wake on demand ([cloudflare-supp-agents-sdk]). One community report says CPU-time limits (30s free tier, 15min paid) don't suit long-running agent tasks ([cloudflare-comm-9]); this is a limitation, not a contradiction of the documented capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that cron, Workflows or scheduled agents work as documented; in-depth docs on scheduling and trigger configuration; clarity on how CPU-time limits affect long-running autonomous jobs.
